# Barbershop tattoo ink picker -- generated by
# harness/tattoo/ink_barbershop.py. The designer's elf_ink_set_* twins
# write globals because it has no character; these write the character's
# own ed_ink_* variables, which the trait portrait modifier already reads.

elf_ink_bb_set_target = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = {
		value
	}

	effect = {
		set_variable = { name = ed_ink_target value = scope:value }
		elf_ink_bb_load_current = yes
	}

	is_shown = {}
	is_valid = {}
}

elf_ink_bb_set_hue = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = {
		value
	}

	effect = {
		set_variable = { name = ed_ink_cur_hue value = scope:value }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ed_ink_cur_sat } } set_variable = { name = ed_ink_cur_sat value = 100 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ed_ink_cur_val } } set_variable = { name = ed_ink_cur_val value = 70 } }
		elf_ink_bb_store_current = yes
	}

	is_shown = {}
	is_valid = {}
}

elf_ink_bb_set_sat = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = {
		value
	}

	effect = {
		set_variable = { name = ed_ink_cur_sat value = scope:value }
		elf_ink_bb_store_current = yes
	}

	is_shown = {}
	is_valid = {}
}

elf_ink_bb_set_val = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = {
		value
	}

	effect = {
		set_variable = { name = ed_ink_cur_val value = scope:value }
		elf_ink_bb_store_current = yes
	}

	is_shown = {}
	is_valid = {}
}

elf_ink_bb_clear = {
	scope = character

	effect = {
		elf_ink_bb_clear_current = yes
	}

	is_shown = {}
	is_valid = {}
}
